subject: Credit note VEN022-0016 – input tax credit pending
body:
Dear Evergreen Motors Pvt Ltd team,

We are reconciling our purchases with GSTR-2B and note that invoice VEN022-0016 dated 24 Sep 2025 is not shown in your return. Consequently Rs 2,247 of input tax credit is at risk.

Please report the invoice in your return and confirm once it appears. We will hold the credit note until it is reflected.

Regards,
Accounts team
Sharma Traders Pvt Ltd
